# codesbyshivam

Shivam Taneja is a software engineer and content creator in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. He ships end-to-end products and documents the work. Online he is codesbyshivam. He makes honest, hands-on content for developers and builders: AI tools, engineer life, and a little humour. He consults at KPMG.

codesbyshivam.com is his creator site, with selected posts and a media kit for brand partnerships. His portfolio is shivamtaneja.com. Dev humour also lives at theguyshetoldyouabout.com.
